name: schooly
description: Schooly — SaaS de gestion scolaire multi-établissements (Côte d'Ivoire / Afrique de l'Ouest). Refontiq.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web-admin && npm run build --workspace apps/pwa-parent
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/ui --noEmit && tsc -p packages/db --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web-admin --noEmit && tsc -p apps/pwa-parent --noEmit
scripts.db:types: cd packages/db && supabase gen types typescript --local > src/database.types.ts
